PR Bodies: Since NextJS,  by default, removed Typescript errors check in dev mode,this PR add new Typescript option that allows you to enable error checking in development mode if needed```js// next.config.jsmodule.exports = {  typescript: {    enableDevErrorsCheck: true,  },}``` | ### What?Updates the `with-vitest` example by @leerob with suggesting how to pass tests with `server-only` package usage.### Why?Package usage was commented with description that Vitest not support `server-only`.  But in fact, we can just mock it, like other common external lib and resolve this problem.### How?Two ways:- mock `server-only` directly in the test file- mock `server-only` in the Vitest setup file---
